Follows Part 1 of the Seurat scSLIDE vignette
(<https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/scslide_vignette>) on a ~104k-cell subset of
Ahern et al. 2022 (40 donors: HV, MILD, SEV, CRIT).

Download the `.rds` file from the vignette's Dropbox link, put it next to this notebook,
and knit with `rmarkdown::render("scslide_part1.Rmd")`.

> **Status:** these chunks have not been run yet. Expect small fixes (argument names,
> metadata columns such as `Age` and `Sex`, the effect-size column in `TrajDETest` output).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)

cran_pkgs <- c("Seurat", "princurve", "ggplot2", "ggridges", "remotes", "BiocManager")
for (p in cran_pkgs) if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(p)
if (!requireNamespace("destiny", quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install("destiny")
if (!requireNamespace("BPCells", quietly = TRUE)) remotes::install_github("bnprks/BPCells/r")
if (!requireNamespace("AzimuthAPI", quietly = TRUE)) remotes::install_github("satijalab/AzimuthAPI")

library(Seurat); library(BPCells); library(princurve); library(ggplot2); library(ggridges)

donor_col <- "Donor"; disease_col <- "Disease"; time_col <- "TimeSinceOnset"
celltype_col <- "azimuth_label"
out_dir <- "output"; dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Load, normalize, annotate

```{r load}
object <- readRDS(params$data_file)
stopifnot(all(c(donor_col, disease_col) %in% colnames(object[[]])))
object <- NormalizeData(object)
```

Pan-human Azimuth annotation through the cloud API (needs internet). This adds the
`azimuth_label` cell types and the `azimuth_embed` reduction.

```{r azimuth}
object <- CloudAzimuth(object)
stopifnot(celltype_col %in% colnames(object[[]]), "azimuth_embed" %in% Reductions(object))
object <- FindVariableFeatures(object, nfeatures = 2000)

table(object[[disease_col]][, 1], useNA = "ifany")
length(unique(object[[donor_col]][, 1]))
```

## 2. Prepare the sample-level object

Landmark cells, a disease-oriented (PLS) embedding, and a WNN graph linking every cell to
landmarks. Set `use_wrapper: true` in the header to use the one-call wrapper instead.

```{r wrapper, eval=params$use_wrapper}
object <- PrepareSampleObject(
  object = object, assay = "RNA", add.hvg = TRUE,
  group.by.CorTest = celltype_col, Y = disease_col,
  sketch.training = TRUE, group.by.Sketch = donor_col,
  ncells.per.group = 1000, ncells.landmark = 2000, ncomp = 20,
  pls.function = "cppls", k.nn = 5,
  name.reduction.1 = "azimuth_embed", dims.reduction.1 = 1:128,
  fix.wnn.weights = c(0.5, 0.5), verbose = TRUE
)
```

### 2a. Sketching

```{r sketch, eval=!params$use_wrapper}
# Uniform: 1,000 cells per donor, to balance donors for PLS training
object <- SketchDataByGroup(object, assay = "RNA", ncells = 1000,
  sketched.assay = "TRAINING", method = "Uniform", group.by = donor_col, verbose = FALSE)

# Leverage score: 2,000 diverse landmark cells
object <- SketchData(object, assay = "TRAINING", ncells = 2000,
  sketched.assay = "LANDMARK", method = "LeverageScore", verbose = FALSE)
```

### 2b. Disease-relevant genes and PLS

```{r pls, eval=!params$use_wrapper}
deg_list <- QuickCorTest(object, assay = "TRAINING", layer = "data",
  group.by = celltype_col, Y = disease_col, cor.cutoff = 0.2, verbose = FALSE)
all_HVG <- union(VariableFeatures(object), deg_list)
length(all_HVG)

DefaultAssay(object) <- "TRAINING"
object <- ScaleData(object, features = all_HVG)
object <- RunPLS(object = object, assay = "TRAINING", features = all_HVG,
  ncomp = 20, Y = c(disease_col), pls.function = "cppls", verbose = FALSE)
```

### 2c. Project PLS onto all cells and build the WNN graph

```{r wnn, eval=!params$use_wrapper}
proj.pls <- ProjectCellEmbeddings(query = object, query.assay = "RNA",
  reference = object, reference.assay = "TRAINING", reduction = "pls",
  dims = 1:20, scale = TRUE, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", verbose = TRUE)
object[["proj.pls"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = proj.pls, key = "pPLS_", assay = "RNA")
rm(proj.pls); invisible(gc())

DefaultAssay(object) <- "RNA"
object <- FindmmNN(object, sketch.assay = "LANDMARK",
  reduction.list = list("azimuth_embed", "proj.pls"), k.nn = 5,
  nn.name = "weighted.nn", dims.list = list(1:128, 1:20), fix.wnn.weights = c(0.5, 0.5))

# Optional single-modality graph (PLS only)
object <- FindsmNN(object, sketch.assay = "LANDMARK", reduction = "proj.pls",
  k.nn = 5, dims = 1:20, nn.name = "single.nn")
```

## 3. Sample-level embedding and diffusion map

```{r sample}
sample_obj <- GenerateSampleObject(object = object, sketch.assay = "LANDMARK",
  nn.name = "weighted.nn", group.by = donor_col, rename.group.by = celltype_col,
  k.nn = 5, normalization.method = "ChiSquared", add.meta.data = TRUE, return.seurat = TRUE)
sample_obj <- ScaleData(sample_obj, features = rownames(sample_obj),
  do.scale = FALSE, do.center = TRUE)

sample_obj <- RunDiffusionMap(sample_obj, assay = "LMC", layer = "scale.data",
  features = rownames(sample_obj), ncomp = 10)

dc <- Embeddings(sample_obj, "DiffMap")[, 1:3]
sample_obj$DC1 <- dc[, 1]; sample_obj$DC2 <- dc[, 2]; sample_obj$DC3 <- dc[, 3]
```

```{r diffmap-plots}
DimPlot(sample_obj, reduction = "DiffMap", dims = c(1, 2), group.by = disease_col)
DimPlot(sample_obj, reduction = "DiffMap", dims = c(1, 3), group.by = disease_col)
```

```{r dc-time, eval=FALSE}
# Off by default: set eval=TRUE if the sample metadata has a time-since-onset column
df <- sample_obj[[]]
ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[time_col]], y = DC3, color = .data[[disease_col]])) +
  geom_point() + theme_classic()
```

## 4. Joint pseudo-trajectory (principal curve)

```{r princurve}
princurve_res <- princurve::principal_curve(
  Embeddings(sample_obj, "DiffMap")[, 1:2], plot = FALSE, maxit = 20, trace = TRUE)
sample_obj$traj_overall <- as.numeric(princurve_res$lambda)
```

## 5. Differential expression along each DC (CD14 monocytes)

```{r pseudobulk}
bulk_obj <- AggregateExpression(object, assays = "RNA",
  group.by = c(donor_col, celltype_col), return.seurat = TRUE)
sub_bulk_obj <- subset(bulk_obj, subset = azimuth_label == "CD14 monocyte")

# Merge sample-level covariates; AggregateExpression can rewrite "_" as "-"
norm_id <- function(x) gsub("_", "-", as.character(x))
sample_meta <- sample_obj[[]]
idx <- match(norm_id(sub_bulk_obj[[]][[donor_col]]), norm_id(rownames(sample_meta)))
stopifnot(!anyNA(idx))

for (v in c("Age", "Sex", disease_col)) {
  if (v %in% colnames(sample_meta)) sub_bulk_obj[[v]] <- sample_meta[[v]][idx]
}
sub_bulk_obj$traj_DC1 <- sample_meta$DC1[idx]
sub_bulk_obj$traj_DC2 <- sample_meta$DC2[idx]
sub_bulk_obj$traj_DC3 <- sample_meta$DC3[idx]
sub_bulk_obj$log_count <- log(Matrix::colSums(
  LayerData(sub_bulk_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")))
```

DC2 and DC3 are fit on patients only (healthy donors removed).

```{r de}
non_health_idx <- which(sub_bulk_obj[[disease_col]][, 1] != "HV")
lv <- c("Age", "Sex", "log_count")

de_dc1 <- TrajDETest(sub_bulk_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts",
  traj.var = "traj_DC1", latent.vars = lv)
de_dc2 <- TrajDETest(sub_bulk_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts",
  traj.var = "traj_DC2", latent.vars = lv, samples = non_health_idx)
de_dc3 <- TrajDETest(sub_bulk_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts",
  traj.var = "traj_DC3", latent.vars = lv, samples = non_health_idx)

# Top 20 up and 20 down genes. The effect-size column is found by pattern;
# check names(de_dc1) if this fails.
top_genes <- function(res, n = 20) {
  res <- as.data.frame(res)
  eff <- grep("coef|logfc|log2fc|estimate|beta", colnames(res),
              ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  stopifnot(!is.na(eff))
  ord <- res[order(res[[eff]], decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  unique(c(head(rownames(ord), n), tail(rownames(ord), n)))
}
DEG_DC1 <- top_genes(de_dc1); DEG_DC2 <- top_genes(de_dc2); DEG_DC3 <- top_genes(de_dc3)
```

### Heatmaps ordered by each DC

```{r heatmaps, fig.height=7}
sub_bulk_obj2 <- subset(sub_bulk_obj, cells = colnames(sub_bulk_obj)[non_health_idx])
cols_all <- c("#f8766d", "cornsilk", "#7cae02", "blue1", "#01bfc4", "#c77cff")

draw <- function(obj, feats, dc, cols) {
  obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = feats)
  PlotAnnotatedHeatmap(object = obj, features = feats, sort.by = dc,
    anno.var = disease_col, anno.colors = list(cols),
    hm.colors = c("blue", "white", "red"))
}
draw(sub_bulk_obj,  DEG_DC1, "traj_DC1", cols_all)
draw(sub_bulk_obj2, DEG_DC2, "traj_DC2", cols_all[-1])
draw(sub_bulk_obj2, DEG_DC3, "traj_DC3", cols_all[-1])
```
